ways.label: Mount Aicken Track to the bushline

start.name: northern end of Arthur's Pass village
start.quote: northern end of Arthur's Pass village

ways.distance: 2.8 km (540 vertical climb) to the bushline return via same track
evidence: Start on the Devils Punchbowl Walking Track at the northern end of Arthur's Pass village, just off SH73.
This track ends at the bushline as there have been multiple fatalities from inexperienced trampers/walkers falling to their deaths.

doubts: Start is not a named place; no feature clearly matches (Devils Punchbowl road-end features are at the railway tunnel), so ref null. Turnoff from Devils Punchbowl track is said to be 15 min up it.
